title: Combo Card Creator
subtitle: A tool for creating and assigning printable BR-branded combo cards.
key_concept: Customizable card templates for combos, auto-assigned to students.
visual_metaphor: A scriptorium desk with quill and parchment, where a master scribe (teacher) creates illuminated cards, each card a miniature cathedral window with 1-5 combo slots.
why_it_matters: Enabled creation of physical learning aids that bridge digital and tangible learning.
zone_change: Crossed border: Digital to Physical — from screen-based to printable resources.
